---
title: 'Build and ship'
status: implemented
description: 'Task guides for projects, pipelines, builds, sources, signing, and delivery.'
---

These guides each do one job on an Oore instance that already runs. If you are
starting from nothing, follow [Get started](/start) first. It strings the
tasks below into one path for Android and one for iOS.

## Set up what Oore builds

- [Create a project](/build/projects/create) for each repository.
- [Configure a pipeline in the UI](/build/pipelines/use-the-ui) from a
  template.
- [Move a pipeline into `.oore.yaml`](/build/pipelines/oore-yaml) so it
  changes with the code. This page also helps you pick a format.
- [Use secrets in a pipeline](/build/pipelines/secrets) for tokens and keys.
- [Set triggers, timeouts, and approvals](/build/pipelines/triggers).

## Run and control builds

- [Trigger a build](/build/run/trigger) by hand.
- [Approve a build](/build/run/approve) that waits for a maintainer.
- [Cancel a build](/build/run/cancel).
- [Retry a store upload](/build/run/retry-step) without rebuilding.

## Build on every push and pull request

These guides need [External Access](/team/access).

- [Connect GitHub](/build/sources/github) or [connect GitLab](/build/sources/gitlab).
- [See builds on pull requests](/build/run/pull-request-checks), with app size
  and size budgets.
- [Troubleshoot source webhooks](/build/sources/webhooks/troubleshoot).

## Sign builds

- [Add Android signing](/build/sign/android), and
  [keep local Gradle signing working](/build/sign/android/gradle).
- [Configure App Store Connect signing](/build/sign/ios/app-store-connect),
  the shortest path for iOS.
- [Configure manual iOS signing](/build/sign/ios/manual) with
  [certificates and profiles you export](/build/sign/ios/certificates).

## Deliver builds

| Goal                                       | Guide                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Get a file from a build                    | [Download a build artifact](/build/distribute/download)                                                        |
| Install an APK on a phone                  | [Install an Android build](/build/distribute/install/android)                                                  |
| Install an iOS build on a test iPhone      | [Register an iOS test device](/build/distribute/ios-devices), then [install it](/build/distribute/install/ios) |
| Send builds to Google Play                 | [Publish to Google Play](/build/distribute/google-play)                                                        |
| Send builds to TestFlight or the App Store | [Publish to TestFlight and the App Store](/build/distribute/app-store)                                         |
| Move a tested build to production          | [Promote builds between environments](/build/distribute/environments)                                          |

## Next step

New to Oore? Start with [Choose your path](/start). Otherwise, pick the guide
for your goal above.
